source: Pinned Api/Types/Certificate.hs190–218 and241–244 encode CastVote as cast_vote with reward_account_path and vote. Api/Types.hs930–942 uses these in coin-selection; confirmed actual modern202 and deprecated202 responses contain this certificate.
failure: reference-voting-coherent/live.json fails strict202 response schema at /coin_selection/certificates/1/certificate_type; response retained in voting-schema-audit/construct.json
proposed_change: Extend only the owned certificate schema with disjoint cast_vote branch requiring exact type, five-component reward path and existing ApiDRep schema. Preserve legacy branches, original OpenAPI, all643 obligations and strict media/status/schema/error checks. Add regression accepting actual202, rejecting missing/invalid vote, bad path and invented types; rerun all coherent evidence. External/combined vote certificates stay explicit future gaps.

prepared_correction.before:
x-certificate: &certificate
  description: |
    A delegation certificate belonging to wallet

    Only for 'join_pool' the 'pool' property is required.
  type: object
  required:
    - certificate_type
    - reward_account_path
  properties:
    certificate_type:
      type: string
      enum: ["join_pool", "quit_pool", "register_reward_account"]
    pool:
      <<: *stakePoolId
    reward_account_path:
      <<: *rewardAccountPath
prepared_correction.after:
x-certificate: &certificate
  oneOf:
    - description: Legacy delegation certificate belonging to wallet
      type: object
      required: [certificate_type, reward_account_path]
      properties:
        certificate_type:
          type: string
          enum: ["join_pool", "quit_pool", "register_reward_account"]
        pool:
          <<: *stakePoolId
        reward_account_path:
          <<: *rewardAccountPath
    - description: Haskell-owned vote delegation certificate
      type: object
      required: [certificate_type, reward_account_path, vote]
      properties:
        certificate_type:
          type: string
          enum: ["cast_vote"]
        reward_account_path:
          <<: *rewardAccountPath
        vote:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApiDRep'
